name: Pocket Pet
description: An original virtual-pet demonstration on the shared Wildlands ECS. Hatch an egg, keep its needs balanced and discover which adult form your care produces.

needs.name: Fullness
needs.description: Meals fill it; it empties steadily while awake.

needs.name: Happiness
needs.description: Play, cuddles and treats raise it.

needs.name: Energy
needs.description: Spent while awake and playing; restored by sleep with the lights off.

needs.name: Cleanliness
needs.description: Drops over time and faster beside messes. Clean up to restore it.

species.name: Mochi
species.description: A rosy sprout-creature that loves snacks and slow afternoons.

species.name: Pebble
species.description: A cool-blue sprout-creature with a curious streak.

models.name: Egg
models.description: Warm it with cuddles to hatch sooner.

models.name: Sprout
models.description: Playful and curious; care quality now shapes the adult.

models.name: Bloom
models.description: Raised with attentive care; wears a blossom crown.

models.name: Bramble
models.description: Raised with several care mistakes; thorny but loyal.

actions.name: Meal
actions.description: A filling bowl of rice and greens.

actions.name: Snack
actions.description: A cupcake treat. Too many in an hour cause a tummy ache.

actions.name: Clean up
actions.description: Bubbles wash the pet and remove every mess.

actions.name: Cuddle
actions.description: A gentle hug. Warming the egg helps it hatch sooner.

actions.name: Medicine
actions.description: Cures sickness and restores some health.
